description: React component for a Stripe payment form handling credit card input, validation, and submission.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Interface representing a payment input element with validation state.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Handles change events from card input elements, updating validation state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, creates payment method via Stripe, and triggers payment process.

methods.name: handleAuthentication
methods.description: Confirms card payment with Stripe using client secret and payment method.
